judgment_refs.phrase: Such a rate of speed as to endanger the life, limb or property of any person
judgment_refs.note: Measure original speed, pedestrian/property body gaps, contact, forward-time and braking proxies; no numeric legal endangerment threshold is inferred.

measurement.method: authored controller target; original realized speed measured separately

axes.range_rationale: The three planned 3/5/7 m/s engineering contrasts bracket a moderate alley speed without creating a legal cutoff.
axes.spacing_rationale: Two m/s spacing gives low, middle and high requested-speed points.
axes.feasibility_evidence: alley_route.control_step and alley_geometry.plan_alley pass CPU tests; selected source-backed alley geometry remains unconstructed.

sweep_specs.rationale: Finite requested-speed judgment sampling must be bound to a selected source-backed alley route and original measured motion.
